title: Budget and Revenue
text:
This page compares each film’s production budget with its worldwide box-office revenue. The scatterplot Figure 1 shows that relationship across the films in the dataset.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million USD)")
plt.title("Film budget and worldwide revenue")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Production budget and worldwide revenue for 104 films (millions of US dollars).

title: Box Office Numbers
text:
This dataset contains 104 well-known films from 1980 to 2025. The data parameters include approximate budgets, worldwide revenues, runtimes, and ratings. The budget and revenue figures are approximate, rounded values in millions of US dollars and are not adjusted for inflation. The data are intended for classroom exploration rather than research.
The website explore the analyses: Budget and Revenue, Runtime and Ratings, and The Bond Films.
Aside from Lecture 10 and 11, I used AI agent Codex for assistance and debugging.

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
Figure Figure 1 compares runtimes and IMDb ratings for the films. Each point represents one film.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.title("Film runtime and IMDb rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Runtime and IMDb rating for each film.






Mean IMDb rating by decade

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)

title: The Bond Films
text:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]

This page follows worldwide revenue across the James Bond films in the dataset. The films represented here span from 1995 to 2021.

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million USD)")
plt.title("Worldwide revenue of James Bond films")
plt.show()
